newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Broadcasting says sales to rise.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Broadcasting says sales to rise.

text.p: Hungarian Broadcasting Corp said on Friday that it expected an upward momentum in revenues to continue after the relaunch of its Budapest-based television station.

In addition, the company said it believes its existing cash balance, cash from future operations and the proceeds from a planned securities offering will be sufficient to fund the company's operations for the next 12 months, but "If the planned offering is delayed or canceled, the company may need to raise funds from financial institutions or from other investors."

"Since the relaunch of its Budapest-based television station, MSAT, in April 1996, revenues on a month-to-month basis have dramatically increased from nine million forints in May 1996 to 39 million forints in November 1996 to current levels of over 60 million forints," it said in a statement.
"The company believes that its rapid growth of sales will continue," it added.

In February, the company sold in a secondary public offering 426,500 units of convertible preferred stock and warrants for proceeds of $3,292,138. Hungarian Broadcasting Inc is a satellite-to-cable television broadcaster.
